title: PopGeneticsPro: a browser-based platform for plant population genetics with codominant, dominant, sequence and morphological data
description:
PopGeneticsPro is a self-contained web application for the analysis of plant population genetic data entirely in the browser, with no installation and no server-side computation. It handles codominant markers (microsatellites, SNPs, isozymes), dominant binary markers (AFLP, ISSR, RAPD), haploid and sequence data (chloroplast and mitochondrial alignments) and morphological characters within one guided workflow: data import from spreadsheets and the file formats of the classical programs, with a data template designer and quality control; allele frequencies and diversity indices; Hardy-Weinberg and linkage disequilibrium tests; F-statistics and hierarchical AMOVA; genetic distances with ordination and trees; Bayesian clustering and assignment; sequence diversity, neutrality tests, haplotype networks and divergence times; bottleneck tests, effective population size, fine-scale spatial genetic structure and the mating system. It ends in editable publication-quality figures and an automatic report with a methods paragraph.

The archive includes six example data sets and a user manual in Spanish (HTML and PDF).
